results.title: Robotics Technicians Career Guide: Salary, Skills, Training & Job Outlook
results.snippet: Robotics technicians install, maintain, troubleshoot, and program robotic systems used in manufacturing, logistics, research, and service applications. Working alongside robotics engineers, they ensure automation systems operate reliably, safely, and efficiently. If you enjoy hands-on technical work, programming, and problem-solving at the intersection of mechanics, electronics, and software, a career as a robotics technician may be ideal. results.title: What Does a Robotics Technician Do? | Goodwin University
results.snippet: Robotics technicians typically work within manufacturing facilities, but may specialize in a certain area of manufacturing such as aerospace, automotive, or medical device production. They may work on-site at production plants, in testing labs, or right in the operations of robots makers. Depending on where you work, the environment may differ.
